question: Who arrests Mariah at Harlem's Paradise in Luke Cage S2#12: Ridley or Misty? The stage text and both card lines say Ridley arrests her (st-priscilla-ridley|st-tom-ridenhour:2 also says 'she arrests Mariah Dillard').
options: Change to Misty arresting Mariah with Ridley there (e.g. 'Ridley backs the case against Mariah, and after Shades hands over the gun, Mariah is arrested at her club' with cards adjusted)
their_evidence: Sources conflict. The MCU wiki's episode page, Misty Knight page and Shades page say Knight arrests Mariah once Shades hands her the gun; the Priscilla Ridley and Mariah Stokes pages say Ridley takes her into custody and tells her a court of law will convict her. The episode transcript has the arrest line ('Mariah Stokes Dillard, you are under arrest...') without speaker labels. Wikipedia only says 'Dillard is arrested.'
